title: Portfolio Website
summary: Personal portfolio with MDX case studies, project filtering, responsive layout, and polished motion—built as a showcase for full-stack and creative work.

heroSlides.caption: Home page: introduction, portrait and résumé link.

A project page: status, timeline, summary and the image carousel.

body.raw:
# Project overview

This site is both **the product and the case study**: content-driven project pages, technology filters, skill-based browsing, and a layout tuned for reading and navigation on any screen size.

## Highlights

- **MDX + Contentlayer** for project content with a typed, rebuild-friendly pipeline.
- **Framer Motion** for section and card motion with respect for reduced-motion preferences.
- **Structured frontmatter** (tech stacks, tags, hero galleries) powering cards, filters, and SEO.

## Next steps

Replace the hero placeholder with a full-bleed screenshot or short loop of the live site when ready.
